caps: Kaikeyi *LOVED* Ram. | So why did she | *SEND HIM AWAY?*
lines.tts: Kaikeyi loved Ram. So why did she send him away?

caps: Welcome to *PART 2* | of the *RAMAYAN* series.
lines.tts: Welcome to part two of the Ramayan series.

caps: King *DASHARATHA* decided: | tomorrow, *RAM* | will be crowned prince.
lines.tts: King Dasharatha decided: tomorrow, Ram will be crowned prince.

caps: *AYODHYA* lit up. | But one maid, *MANTHARA,* | watched from the terrace.
lines.tts: Ayodhya lit up. But one maid, Manthara, watched from the terrace.

caps: She ran to queen *KAIKEYI.* | And Kaikeyi was *OVERJOYED!*
She gave Manthara | a *JEWEL.*
lines.tts: She ran to queen Kaikeyi. And Kaikeyi was overjoyed! She gave Manthara a jewel.

caps: I see no difference | between *RAM AND BHARAT!*
lines.tts: I see no difference between Ram and Bharat!

caps: Manthara threw the jewel *AWAY.* | Wake up! Ram will *BANISH* | your Bharat, or worse.
lines.tts: Manthara threw the jewel away. Wake up! Ram will banish your Bharat, or worse.

caps: Remember the war? | You *SAVED THE KING'S LIFE,*
and he gave you | *TWO BOONS.* | Use them now.
lines.tts: Remember the war? You saved the king's life, and he gave you two boons. Use them now.

caps: So Kaikeyi tore off her jewels, | and lay on the floor | of the *ROOM OF ANGER.*
lines.tts: So Kaikeyi tore off her jewels, and lay on the floor of the room of anger.

caps: The king found her there, | and swore by *RAM* himself | to give her anything.
lines.tts: The king found her there, and swore by Ram himself to give her anything.

caps: *FIRST BOON:* | crown Bharat.
*SECOND:* send Ram | to the forest, | for *14 YEARS.*
lines.tts: First boon: crown Bharat. Second: send Ram to the forest, for fourteen years.

caps: Dasharatha *FELL.* | He begged her all night. | She would not move.
lines.tts: Dasharatha fell. He begged her all night. She would not move.

caps: At dawn, Ram heard it, | and his face | *DID NOT CHANGE.*
Let it be. | *I WILL GO.*
lines.tts: At dawn, Ram heard it, and his face did not change. Let it be. I will go.

caps: *PART 3:* the king remembers | a *CURSE* from his youth, | and it comes *TRUE.*
lines.tts: Part three: the king remembers a curse from his youth, and it comes true.

caps: *FOLLOW* | so you don't miss it,
and comment | *JAI SHRI RAM!*
lines.tts: Follow, so you don't miss it, and comment, Jai Shri Ram!
